name: crypto-order-book-depth
title: Crypto Order Book Depth: Liquidity and Slippage by Exchange
description: Live spot order books from OKX, Gate, Bitget and KuCoin turned into the numbers a desk trades on: resting depth within 0.5, 1 and 2 per cent of mid, the slippage a given order size would pay, and which venue fills that size cheapest. Keyless, no browser.
